Container.Name: MooNs
Container.Overview: MooNs is a self-hosted, real-time collaborative travel planner with interactive maps, budgets, bookings, packing lists, file management, and more. Plan trips together with your group — changes sync instantly across all connected users. Includes OIDC/SSO support, dark mode, PWA, and modular addons.

Config.Name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: At-rest encryption key for stored secrets (API keys, MFA, SMTP, OIDC).

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal server port (must match the container port mapping above).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for logs, reminders and scheduled tasks (e.g. Europe/Berlin).

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: info = concise user actions, debug = verbose admin-level details.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_LANGUAGE
Config.Description: Default language shown on the login page.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: Public base URL of this instance.

Config.Name: ADMIN_EMAIL
Config.Description: Email for the first admin account created on initial boot.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the first admin account created on initial boot.
